capabilities: : Filter and query notes using properties
intentEvidence: Paperless Sync connects the two: the lease agreement sits next to your moving checklist, the doctor's report links to your health notes
motivation: Paperless Sync connects the two: the lease agreement sits next to your moving checklist, the doctor's report links to your health notes, and every invoice from 2024 is one query away.
problem: Users need a way to connect structured document data stored in Paperless-ngx with the linking and querying capabilities of Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Sync document metadata from Paperless-ngx into notes.

summary: Turns documents stored in Paperless-ngx into individual Obsidian notes, mapping metadata to properties and allowing cross-note querying.
